name: input_alignment
command: Rscript -e 'x<-read.delim("Demo/WGCNA_fpkm_data.txt",check.names=FALSE,row.names=1);y<-read.delim("Demo/WGCNA_data_trait.txt",check.names=FALSE,row.names=1);stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(x)),!anyDuplicated(colnames(x)),!anyDuplicated(rownames(y)),identical(colnames(x),rownames(y)),all(is.finite(as.matrix(x))),all(is.finite(as.matrix(y))));cat(nrow(x),ncol(x),"gene/sample IDs unique and trait order identical\n")'
